description: Apply when a mobile webview app's fetch throws 'Load failed'/'Failed to fetch' with no status/body against a server that works elsewhere — the response is CORS-blocked; diagnose via the server's Access-Control-Allow-Origin header, not app code.

Apply when a SolidJS context provider's init throws under a condition — gate it with <Show when={cond} fallback={recoveryUI}> around the provider; SolidJS lazily instantiates Show children so the throwing init never runs while cond is falsy. Gate on the signal that is actually falsy at throw time, not a related-but-truthy one.

Apply before reaching for ios-keyboard-plist or ios-keyboard-layout skills — first verify a native iOS keyboard extension target actually exists; in Tauri/Capacitor mobile forks the keyboard UI may be shared SolidJS in a WebView (e.g. prompt-input.tsx) with NO native extension, so those native-keyboard skills do not apply.
